_comment: Cases where the apps cannot match exactly, with both outputs pinned. Anything not listed here must match iOS. Adding an entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

differences.kotlin: 予算|について|決まり|した
differences.reason: Japanese word breaking. iOS uses Apple's own morphological tokenizer; Android's BreakIterator is stock ICU, which splits some particles differently. Only keyword search and citation matching read these terms, and both sets still find the meeting.
